# Mapping and Extracting Data from ALFRED.7 (2026-02-02 19:49Z)

_**User (2026-02-02 20:07Z)**_

I want to map the entirety of the contents of Alfred.7. 

in the script there is a list of RLE compressed byte streams, in the "budas" array. It only has a start offset since the RLE compressed algorithm works until it finds the sequence "BUDA". Some of these budas have an additional "offset" attribute that offsets from the "start_offset". many are 768 and that means those are palettes, you can add those to the raw list as well with name "palette".

There is another list of "direct" bitmap copies, that indicates start and end of byte sequences that are raw bitmaps with no compression. 

Then there is unmapped byte sequences. I want to add those to the "raw" array.

In the end the script should extract all "budas" and all raw bitmaps as PNG, and all raw unidentified byte sequences as ".bin"

I want you to take the info that currently sits on the script, support yourself with the real ALFRED.7 file present in the project (files/ALFRED.7) and add all unidentified byte sequences to the raw array for extraction.
